# CompilationLogLevel

How serious a build message is.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Debug"` | Detail about how the build ran. |
| `"Info"` | Progress and information. |
| `"Warning"` | Something worth fixing that does not stop the build. |
| `"Error"` | A problem that fails the build. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`BuildRecordDiagnostic`](build-record-diagnostic.md)
- Inside [`CompilationLogEntry`](compilation-log-entry.md)
